task_description: Find the maximum element in a list of numbers. Returns None if the list is empty.
flawed_assumption: range() covers the last element or boundary element

task_description: Filters a list of numeric values, returning a new list containing only the elements that are greater than or equal to the specified threshold. Non-numeric values in the input list are ignored.
flawed_assumption: A boundary threshold is strictly greater/less when it should include the boundary value (or vice versa)

task_description: Calculates the percentage of scores that are greater than or equal to the threshold, rounded to 2 decimal places. Returns 0.0 if the input list is empty or invalid.
flawed_assumption: Integer division (//) preserves precision or truncation before rounding yields expected results
